---
name: 🚀 Pull Request
about: Submit your changes for review
---

## 📝 Summary

Briefly describe the changes introduced by this PR. Mention any related issues
using keywords (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## ✨ Type of Change

- [ ] ✍️ Text (new or revised prose in the manuscript)
- [ ] 📊 Figures or tables
- [ ] 📚 References (citations or `references.bib`)
- [ ] 🧮 Equations, derivations, or appendices
- [ ] 🧪 Scripts or data used to produce results
- [ ] 🔁 Response to referee comments
- [ ] ⚙️ Build, CI, or tooling
- [ ] 🐛 Fix (typo, broken reference, compilation error)

## 📍 Affected Sections

List the sections, figures, or tables changed (e.g., Sec. 3, figure 2).

## 🧪 How Has This Been Checked

- [ ] `make` compiles without errors or undefined references.
- [ ] `uv run prek run --all-files` passes.
- [ ] I have read the changed pages in the compiled PDF.

## 🏗️ Checklist

- [ ] The changes follow the
      [CQG author guidelines](https://publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org/journals/classical-and-quantum-gravity/).
- [ ] The abstract is at most 300 words, with no references, undefined acronyms,
      or figure, table, or equation numbers.
- [ ] New figures are vector PDF/EPS where possible, have 8 to 12 pt text, and
      do not rely on colour alone.
- [ ] New figure file names use only `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, and `_`.
- [ ] Every new citation exists in `references.bib` and supports the claim it is
      attached to.
- [ ] New numbers can be traced to the script, data, and commit that produced
      them.
- [ ] I have updated the acknowledgments, funding, author contributions, or data
      availability sections if needed.

## 📷 Screenshots (if applicable)

Add screenshots of the changed pages of the compiled PDF here.
